stem.zh-CN: 关于[[term:decoder-only|Decoder-only]]，下列哪一项说法是错误的？
stem.en-US: Which statement about [[term:decoder-only|decoder-only]] models is incorrect?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:decoder-only|Decoder-only]] 模型没有独立 Encoder，通常通过上下文[[term:autoregressive-generation|自回归预测]]后续 token。
explanation.en-US: [[term:decoder-only|Decoder-only]] models do not have a separate encoder and usually predict the next token autoregressively from the context.
